//: End the mission the way the game ends it, and LEAVE it: win -> battle summary -> geoscape. The other half of start-mission, which only ever got you IN.
//lever: The console `win`/`lose` sets every faction's outcome and then calls TacticalLevelController.GameOver() (TacticalLevelController.cs:1051-1065, :1092-1108). GameOver raises wrapping-up, runs cleanup/XP/telemetry, raises GameOverEvent and tears the mod hooks down (:825-843) - materially better than assigning IsGameOver or calling FinishLevel by hand, both of which skip all of that.
//exit: The callback that actually leaves tactical is private TacticalView.GoToGeoscape(), which builds a TacticalGameResult and calls PhoenixGame.FinishLevel (TacticalView.cs:1112-1120, PhoenixGame.cs:262-265). It is the battle-summary button's own callback (:1109); invoking it is pressing that button, not a shortcut past it.
//rewards: The post-mission REWARD screen only exists if tactical was entered from a REAL GeoMission: the launch stores _missionToComplete (GeoLevelController.cs:1412-1466) and the return calls _missionToComplete.Complete(result) then resets the view with LastMission/CompletedMissionResult (:683-713).
//synthetic: A `start-mission` / `build-mission` mission (console loadmap) has NO geoscape to return to: GoToGeoscape there RELOADS the same map as a fresh turn-1 tactical level (live 2026-09-28, D:\PP-Instance3: `left` timed out at 180 s reading `tactical`, IsGameOver false, squad back at full AP). Pass `{"lobby":true}` for those: after GameOver it leaves through PhoenixGame.FinishLevelAndGoToLobby(0) and waits for `phase:menu` (live: 6 ms). Default false = the real-campaign path to the geoscape.
//check: The proof of arrival is `@viewstate`, which is re-read from the live view every call (PPBridgeMain.Roots). Read it, do not hold a handle to it: entering a UI state the stack has already popped is how this project has broken the geoscape before.

steps.//: `win` or `lose`. Both end through GameOver(); which one only changes the factions' recorded outcome.
GameOver switches the view to its own end state on a LATER frame - a battle summary, or a cutscene that ends in the same callback (TacticalView.cs:1100-1109). Let it land before pressing its button.
Synthetic mission: the lobby is the only way out (see //synthetic). The same AFTER/AFTERVIEW names are saved on both branches so `output` resolves either way.
Unloading tactical and loading the geoscape is a scene change, so every handle taken above is from a dead epoch by the time this returns. Nothing below reads one.

`phase:geoscape` says the CONTROLLER exists; the view enters its first UI state a frame or two later, and a `roots` read taken in that gap reported geoState as a null (it used to read `unresolved`, which was worse - it named a step nobody mistyped). @viewstate is re-resolved live on every poll and refuses while it is null, so this waits for the screen itself rather than for a duration.

finally.//: MANDATORY, and deliberately EMPTY of restores: this plan ends a mission on purpose and there is nothing to put back. What it does owe is a final honest reading of where the game now is, taken even when the plan failed half way.
